AboutPage.title: Design useful products, ship them cleanly
AboutPage.subtitle: A human-sized product and development studio with direct communication.
AboutPage.storyBody:
Yodev starts from a simple principle: fewer intermediaries make it easier to understand the problem and decide quickly.

Each engagement begins with concrete framing and progresses through verifiable deliverables. Constraints, trade-offs and limits remain visible throughout the project.

The goal is not to sell an abstract transformation, but to ship a useful, maintainable and transferable product.

values.title: Build and verify
values.description: Each increment is tied to a need, acceptance criteria and evidence that it works.

values.title: Useful transparency
values.description: Budget, timeline, risks and trade-offs are visible while decisions can still be made.

values.title: Transferable product
values.description: Code, documentation and access are organized to avoid artificial dependency on the provider.

sections.title: Data and purposes
sections.content: The form collects your name, email, message and, if provided, organization, budget and product of interest. Fields marked * are required to assess and reply to your request; other fields are optional. Do not send passwords, health data or other sensitive information. You are not automatically subscribed to a newsletter.

sections.title: Legal basis
sections.content: Assessing a request for services is based on steps taken at your request before entering into a contract. Other enquiries and abuse prevention rely on our legitimate interest in answering requests and protecting the website. We do not make automated decisions that produce legal effects concerning you.

sections.title: Recipients and providers
sections.content: Requests are accessible to the person responsible for replying at Yodev. Vercel hosts the website, Resend transmits emails, and the email provider stores received correspondence. The rate-limiting service receives only pseudonymous identifiers and temporary counters, without the content of your request. Data is neither sold nor used for targeted advertising.

sections.title: Retention
sections.content: Enquiries that do not lead to a business relationship are removed from the mailbox no later than 12 months after the last exchange. If a contract is concluded, records needed to fulfil the contract and legal obligations follow their own retention periods. Abuse-prevention counters expire after 15 minutes to 24 hours. Application logs exclude names, email addresses and messages; their operational retention is limited to 30 days. Details of provider copies and technical-log retention are available on request.

sections.title: Hosting and international transfers
sections.content: Vercel and Resend may process data outside the European Economic Area, including in the United States. Their data processing agreements provide transfer mechanisms, including European Commission standard contractual clauses where applicable. You can request the list of providers, processing locations and safeguards relevant to your request from our privacy contact.

sections.title: Preferences and duplicate prevention
sections.content: The site includes no advertising trackers. Your selected theme is stored in your browser; a language cookie may remember your language preference. When submitting, session storage may keep a random identifier and a fingerprint of the request valid for up to 23 hours to reuse the same identifier after an interruption. Your name, email address and message are not stored there. These items are removed after success or when the browser session closes.

sections.title: Your rights and complaints
sections.content: You may request access, rectification, erasure or restriction of processing, object to processing based on legitimate interests, and exercise data portability where applicable. Email hello@yodev.fr. Proportionate proof of identity may be requested if there is reasonable doubt. You may also lodge a complaint with the French data protection authority, CNIL, including through cnil.fr.

sections.title: Scope of this policy
sections.content: This policy covers the yodev.fr website and its contact requests. Mail, Ads, Spend and Pressay publish their own information about their accounts and services. For questions about this policy: hello@yodev.fr.

goodFit.title: For you if...

You want direct access to the people designing and building
